definition.name: Copilot Cowork isolated live chat prototype

target.scope_review_required: Confirm API namespace registration and cross-scope access to global Script Includes and sn_cs APIs before installation.

installation_policy.single_legacy_exception: Template only: owner must identify and hash-pin a target-specific legacy fanout rule, if applicable. If absent, no amendment is needed. All-zero sentinels and helper CLI refusal remain.

roles.name: cowork_bridge.integration
roles.description: Restricts the new Scripted REST API; only the dedicated integration account receives this role.

tables.name: u_cowork_command
tables.label: Cowork Command
tables.access_policy: No public/Table API/agent access. Admin-controlled reconciliation and server Script Includes only; do not assign admin to integration user.

tables.name: u_cowork_outbox
tables.label: Cowork Callback Outbox
tables.access_policy: Administrative reconciliation and server-only helpers. Contains approved callback conversation data; no tokens, credentials, HTTP headers or routing properties. No public, agent or integration-user Table API access.

columns.name: u_cowork_session_id
columns.label: Cowork session ID
columns.reason: Many non-Cowork interactions have blank values; avoid a global unique index with release-dependent empty-string semantics. u_cowork_command.u_key supplies the atomic unique reservation.

extensions.field_write_acl: Only the dedicated principal or administrators may set Cowork metadata. Existing end-user or agent table ACLs must not allow arbitrary tagging.
extensions.legacy_ownership_policy: These unrelated fields are optional and must not be created. Guard each runtime read with isValidField; reject either present populated field independently, including partial presence. Installer captures and revalidates presence only, never legacy data.

business_rules.name: Cowork interaction accepted or closed
business_rules.timing_reason: Synchronous after-update snapshots previous and stable transition versions into the durable outbox before best-effort delivery. Own closed events are captured even when new REST operations are disabled.

business_rules.name: Cowork agent message callback
business_rules.timing_reason: Synchronous after-insert snapshots the agent assignment and stable message sys_id. Strict helper checks own interaction, sender, and q_data_message_type.

scheduled_jobs.name: Cowork outbox retry
scheduled_jobs.run_as: Configured dedicated Cowork integration user; operator must resolve its reference before activation.
scheduled_jobs.concurrency: Conditional GlideRecord.updateMultiple leases guarded by sys_mod_count, due time and state; fresh-read verifies random lease token. Lease is 600 seconds; finish updates require its token. Backend dedup remains mandatory for lease expiry after an uncertain send.
scheduled_jobs.prerequisites: Review and install exactly one periodic job; verify scheduler permission, run-as context, updateMultiple compare-and-swap behavior across workers/nodes, auto sys_mod_count, GlideDateTime and gs.generateGUID support; configure ops alert before enabling delivery.

event_registry.name: cowork_bridge.outbox.dead_letter
event_registry.description: Retained event needs operator recovery. Parm1 is stable event ID; parm2 is sanitized error code; no transcript.

operations.required_alert: Configure an operator-owned notification or monitor for cowork_bridge.outbox.dead_letter and the attention/backlog filters; never include u_payload in alerts.
operations.retention: Never purge pending/retry/sending/dead_letter automatically. Retain delivered snapshots/event IDs through backend dedup and approved conversation-data retention windows. No purge job is installed.
operations.retry_policy: Immediate best effort after enqueue; periodic retry up to 8 claims, exponential 30s base backoff capped at 3600s; expired 600s leases recover crashes. Exhaustion retains payload and marks dead_letter plus attention, error log and metadata-only event.

properties.name: cowork_bridge.unavailable_message
properties.value: Live chat is unavailable. Please use your IT support portal.

oauth.inbound: New dedicated OAuth application mapped to new dedicated integration account; no Copilot/Intranet account or credential reuse.
oauth.outbound: New outbound OAuth provider/profile; client credentials stored only in the platform credential store. webhook_oauth_entity is its provider name, webhook_oauth_scope is the backend application URI plus /.default.

legacy_amendment.insert_after: if (ix.getValue('u_cowork_session_id')) return; // Cowork sessions use their isolated callback only.
legacy_amendment.blocked_until: NONDEPLOYABLE TEMPLATE. No target rule or original hash is supplied. Obtain independent target-specific approval, snapshot and hash pin; immediately before any write compare every invariant and revision. Keep private records outside this distribution.

deployment_order: Read-only collision/schema/plugin/license/internal-API checks; export collision candidates. Legacy ownership fields are optional and must not be created. Inspect whether a relevant legacy fanout rule exists.
Review generated definition; keep enabled=false; provision new role, minimum-role integration user, inbound/outbound OAuth apps, backend LiveChat.Webhook role assignment, own queue and channel.
Create command and outbox tables, required unique indexes, interaction fields/index and restrictive ACLs. Verify uniqueness and conditional leases with concurrent workers.
Create disabled/default properties and Script Includes.
Create authenticated REST definition/resources and execute ACL; create inactive callback rules, inactive retry schedule and dead-letter event registry; configure operator notification/monitor.
If no legacy fanout rule exists, skip amendment. Otherwise obtain exact source/revision approval before any narrow amendment; retain sentinel refusal until then.
Configure all Cowork properties; validate outbound token audience/role and backend callback reachability.
Enable new callback rules and retry schedule while bridge/delivery remain disabled; execute gated and wrong-principal probes.
Enable outbox_delivery_enabled after retry/failure/ops tests, then cowork_bridge.enabled last; run isolated open/accept/message/close/idempotency tests.
Rollback order and ambiguous-command recovery are in DEPLOYMENT.txt.

blockers: If a relevant legacy fanout rule exists, fresh-read its revision and compare with a separately approved hash-qualified preview. If absent, do not create or amend legacy rules.
Installer must generate and review instance-specific ACL/index/choice metadata; this bundle does not execute writes.
Namespace/scope, API/plugin compatibility, minimum roles, OAuth providers and all routing values require operator verification.
